hungry_brood.text:
1 brood cells unfed.
The counter can see brood without food, but not whether the trouble is stores, workers, or a delayed journey.
If feeding waits too long, those larvae can starve before they grow.

If food and a nurse are available, directing a worker to nursing can feed the brood, but leaves her other job slower.
If workers or stores are scarce, reduce competing work and watch the cells while you decide what the colony can spare.
hungry_brood.title: Brood without food
